meta.name: orchestrate-batch-refactor
meta.description: Plan and execute large refactor or rewrite efforts efficiently with parallel multi-agent analysis and implementation. Use when a user asks to refactor many files, split workstreams, analyze a target code area, and coordinate sub-agents with clear ownership and dependency-aware execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行分析并执行大规模代码重构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要重构大量文件并协调多个子任务
copy.tagline_en: Plan and execute large-scale code refactoring in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often refactor many files and coordinate sub-tasks

howto.what: Claude 会先并行分析代码范围，然后制定依赖感知的计划，再派发子代理并行执行独立的代码重构或重写任务，最后整合验证并报告结果。
howto.when: 当你要求重构或重写多个文件、拆分工作流、分析目标代码区域时触发。适用于中等或大规模涉及多个文件或子系统的任务。

say.text: 帮我重构 src/ 下的所有模块，保持行为不变。
say.note: Claude 会分析范围、制定计划并派发子代理并行执行。

say.text: 把 utils/ 和 services/ 拆成独立工作包并行重写。
say.note: Claude 会创建依赖图，并行执行独立包。

say.text: 分析 models/ 目录的耦合风险并生成重构计划。
say.note: Claude 会启动 explorer 子代理并行分析。

howto.what_en: Claude will first analyze the code scope in parallel, then build a dependency-aware plan, dispatch sub-agents to execute independent refactor or rewrite tasks concurrently, and finally integrate, verify, and report results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refactor or rewrite many files, split workstreams, or analyze a target code area. Suitable for medium/large scope touching multiple files or subsystems.

say_en.text: Refactor all modules under src/ while preserving behavior.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze scope, plan, and dispatch sub-agents in parallel.

say_en.text: Split utils/ and services/ into independent work packets and rewrite them in parallel.
Analyze coupling risks in models/ and generate a refactor plan.
say_en.note: Claude will launch explorer sub-agents to analyze in parallel.
